title: LumaSip Product Facts
body: LumaSip is a smart hydration bottle with hydration reminders, a 14-day battery, and IPX7 water resistance. These are product facts, not medical claims. Do not state that the bottle cures, treats, or prevents dehydration or disease.

title: US Creator Disclosure Rules
body: Sponsored US creator content must make the relationship clear with a visible #ad disclosure. The disclosure belongs in the content or caption and must not be hidden after more links. Marketing copy must avoid unsupported medical claims.

title: Creator Outreach Tone
body: Outreach should be concise, specific, and respectful. Name the brand, explain why the creator fits, list the requested deliverable, ask for availability and a quote, and avoid promising acceptance before review.

title: LumaSip Delivery Checklist
body: The product should appear in the first five seconds. The creator must mention LumaSip, include #ad, keep the profile link live for seven days, and publish by the campaign deadline. Confirm the final URL and publish time.

title: Prohibited Health Claims
body: Do not claim that LumaSip cures dehydration, treats illness, prevents disease, guarantees athletic performance, or provides a medical diagnosis. Ask for revision when content contains these medical or treatment claims.

title: Campaign Reporting Fields
body: Record creator handle, platform, agreed fee, deliverable URL, publish time, views, engagement, approval state, source date, and any exception. Keep changes traceable to the project and creator.
